method: Andros: the Andros barrier reef and the Tongue of the Ocean wall off the east coast, plus ocean blue holes run as recreational dives; inland blue-hole caves excluded. No Bahamas National Trust dive-site list exists (the North and South Andros marine parks protect the reef without naming sites). Lists: Small Hope Bay Lodge's dive-site, wall, wreck, cavern, blue-hole and shark-dive pages; the tourism list, meaning the Bahamas Ministry of Tourism plan-your-trip dive page and Andros island page together with the My Out Islands Andros diving page, counted as one list; and Kamalame Cay's 2003 Wayback scuba page (three sites, none shared with Small Hope). Andros Beach Club and Andros Diving name no sites on any readable or archived page; Aqua Cat, Aggressor, Blackbeard's and Dolphin Dream publish no readable site list. A site counts when named, recreationally divable and on at least two independent lists, so a Small Hope site counts only when a tourism page also names it. Inland blue holes (The Crater) are excluded. Counted 2026-10-14.
